subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Priviledge"** is** incorrectly spelled**. The** correct spelling is "Privilege". **(विशेषाधिकार)

 
 
• **Example: **Having access to quality education is a **privilege** that not everyone enjoys.
 
 
 
• **"Privilege"** refers to a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार)
 
 
• **Example: **It was a **privilege **to witness such a historic event.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **Privilege.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Recommendation** (सिफारिश): A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

 
 
• **Example:** She gave me a **recommendation** letter for my job application.
 
 
 
• **Affiliate** (संबद्ध): Officially attach or connect (a subsidiary group or a person) to an organization.
 
 
• **Example:** The local club is **affiliated **with the national organization.
 
 
 
• **Parachute** (पैराशूट): A device used to slow the descent of a person or object through the air.
 
 
• **Example:** He jumped out of the plane and deployed his **parachute**..
